notes.title: Latest Update
notes.content:
The latest update includes:

A fix for out of memory issues in Ruins on some Macs

Fixed camera control key bindings all showing Left Arrow

Fixed Jekyll's transform repeatedly operating if he transforms shortly after using Cane Cyclone

notes.title: Post-release fixes and tweaks
notes.content:
We’ve made a few tweaks and fixes since the last update based on the community’s feedback:
[list]
[*]New ability sounds for Snow White, Robin Hood and Dr. Jekyll: we’ve been through and improved pretty much every ability sound in the game
[*]Reduced memory usage in the marsh to avoid a crash happening on some Macs
[*]Fixed a bug with the Madness perpertual motion rune
[/list]

Hope you enjoy …  as ever if there are any issues please email [u]support@chilledmouse.com[/u]

notes.title: Update 18th January (2 updates)
notes.content:
We've made a quick update to fix the bug in the tutorial where text was obscuring the game.

[list]
[*]Bug fix: the game now leaves the game paused in certain tutorial boxes even if you pause and unpause manually, so that you can progress the tutorial - this should fix the issue reported with the switching characters tutorial.
[/list]

Turns out that problem was more complex than we thought - especially in German! So there's a second fix live now.

[list]
[*]Fixed problem with German character swap tutorial box not disappearing
[*]Volume curve for effects and music is now more "natural" (half on the slider sounds more like half the volume)
[*]Narration is now changed by the sound effect volume and not the music volume
[/list]

notes.title: Update 06/01
notes.content:
Hello and Happy new year to everyone!


The latest Torn Tales Beta update is going live on Steam about now. Aside from some fixes to minor bugs, the main changes are:

[list]
[*]Lots of visual improvements rolled out to the rest of the forest
[*]Jekyll now appears in the level by the camp during the tutorial
[*]Changed how shadows look on various settings to (hopefully) better balance performance and visual quality
[*]Engraved another set of names onto gravestones in the forest
[/list]

As always please let us know any feedback via the Steam forum.

notes.title: Update 11/11
notes.content:
A modest update this time with our latest fixes:

[list]
[*]Fix for push back (e.g. from Robin's auto attack) sometimes forcing things off walkable areas of map - e.g. the Romeo skeleton in the Marsh Bookbinder fight
[*]Fix for Bookbinder texturing (he was appearing all white)
[*]Some small visual improvements to the forest, mostly at the start of the tutorial and improvements to the lighting on the floor
[*]Minor typo fixes
[*]More headstones engraved in the forest
[/list]

Keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Update 28/10
notes.content:
Hello,

We have a new update for you with a bunch of added stuff so have a look below.

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Added small power buff to the Swamp creature.
[*]Buffed spiders power slightly.
[*]Buffed Chemical drip range.
[*]Nerfed Huntsman health a bit. Added some sound effects.
[*]Nerfed Juggernaut rune effects by 60%.
[*]Nerfed the intimidate loot effect.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed xp orb sfx volume proportional to xp size.
[*]Reduced footsteps volume.
[*]Added missing cooldown values to loot window descriptions.
[*]Changed mighty blow achievement to not include status effect damage.
[*]Put cutscene dialogue on the music channel.
[*]Implemented Esc key to go back in the main menu pages.
[*]Added option to change characters using portraits or hotkeys while they are dead and the book is open.
[*]Increased the probability of rare loot. Because its more fun.
[*]Added camera rotation to the middle mouse button.
[*]Made the description text about skill unlocking and runes bolder and clearer and made distinction between locked and unlocked runes greater.
[*]Added a return to last save point button in the options menu.
[*]Made some minor spelling/punctuation changes.
[/list]
 
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for getting stuck in forest fences.
[*]Fixed the Ult flash in book draw order bug.
[*]Disabled S, B, I keys in the main menu.
[*]Fix for book disappearing at level 1 when skipping the tutorials.
[*]Fixed persistent resistance tooltip bug.
[*]Fixed book opening behind loot window.
[*]Fix for tooltip popup on skills bar not always triggering.
[*]Fix for the shader that draws loot gems, being occluded by close camera stuff like tall trees.
[*]Minor fixes for some objects missing colliders in the marsh and ice caves.
[*]Added a fix for the marsh bookbinder boss sequence not triggering correctly.
[*]Added a fix for spite achievement not unlocking.
[*]Fix for audible stuff happening in the background while cutscenes playing.
[*]Removed looping effect bug from white fire.
[*]Fix for when the Jeweller achievement is awarded.
[*]Fix for Monster achievement while Hyde is dead.
[*]Tidied up some hovering assets in some levels.
[*]Ice cave Golem trigger now stops characters from running off into the void.
[*]Added a maybe fix for the character switching tutorial bug in a german build.
[*]Fix for bone piles summoning outside of the arena, and fixed bone pile skeleton warriors and saplings not being properly spawned in the arena. (invisible dead chilled skeleton thing bug).
[*]Fix for branch end chests achievement not triggering.
[*]Fixed some wall colliders in the arena.
[*]Fix for achievement data not being saved properly.
[*]Fix for rainbow achievement unlocking prematurely.
[/list]


Have fun playing!

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
Hello everyone (with a key) and co,

Here's a list of the latest fixes in the game. Please keep the feedback coming.

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]GENERAL enemy unit balancing and difficulty curve tweaking
[*]Reduced the trees sapling spawn rate
[*]More balancing for hardcore mode
[*]Reduced Robins crit from 10x to 5x and increased his flow generation rate
[*]Characters now respawn after killing guardians now in arena mode
[*]Reduced the elites count in arena mode packs
[/list] 

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Improvements to wolf and tree sounds + Robins auto + general impact sounds
[*]Added Elite prefix to elite enemy names
[*]Toned down xp orb sounds
[*]Moved the exit button on the options page, made more clear, added are you sure dialogue
[*]Added UI flash to skills and items when equipped into slots
[*]Added camera rotation controls
[*]Changed characters brightness balance and enemies visual shiny-ness
[*]Added character floor movement target indicators
[*]Added a "skip to the swamp" save slot option
[*]Added Elite prefix to elite pack names
[*]Linux version working
[/list]
 
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]All dead ends now have chests, and most have enemies too
[*]Reduced sound frequency for frogs, and ravens
[*]Fix for hardcore mode selection
[*]Fixed marsh crash bug. (Black screen)
[*]Added missing guardian chest to troll
[*]Fixed loot not always rare at side quest ends
[*]Fixes for the tutorials to force them to keep up with players
[*]Fixed resurrect loot effect typo
[*]Added missing German and French translations for a few remaining strings
[*]Added missing animation to Snows blizzard - twister rune
[*]Bug fix for player control when auto reselecting targets
[*]Fixed cutscene skip page turn and audio bug
[*]Added a fix for save file map coverage not resetting on a new map correctly
[*]Fix for the queens summon jekyll doppelganger bug
[*]Fixed wrong key names (alpha1 etc...) in tutorials
[*]Fixed the pushback happening on bosses off cliffs
[*]Fix for chests visual fade out and appearance
[/list]


Stay tuned for more news. Should you have any issues or questions feel free to post in the forums or email us at support@chilledmouse.com

TT Team
